reason: No auto-charge on the trial is nice, so I'd probably try the 14 days for free, but my AirPods already stop the sound when I fall asleep and a free YouTube playlist does the rest. When the trial ends I'd just not pay, like I do with every trial.
objection: My real problem is waking up at 3-4am, and a one-tap 'resume quietly' button doesn't feel like something I should pay monthly for on my salary. A phone-on-the-bed tracker comparing two weeks feels like it could just be noise.
would_change_my_mind: If the day-14 comparison actually showed I fell back asleep after the 3-4am wake noticeably faster, like 15+ minutes, I'd pay the yearly price once.
